observations: body L1-L40: the page continues the list of books: each entry hangs from its abbreviation at the margin; L36 begins a paragraph inside the entry of Naṣīr ad-dīn. The abbreviations and the names of the authors in the titles are letter-spaced (the names in the titles as their editors write them: «el-Bekrí», «Moh’ammed», «Abu ’l-Kásim», «Fárisí al-Istakhrí», with acute or circumflex accents), and so are «Suter», «Assemani», «Margoliouth», «Uri» and «Knobel». The signs = are printed long (10 pt).

body L1, L7, L19, L24, L39: broken letters: the t of «Veneto», the d of «traduit», the l of «paulo» (with a speck), the o of «Bibliotheca»; a mark after «du» is a speck. The Greek «Καρπός» has an acute accent.
body L3: the apostrophes of «’Obeid» and «’Abdallah» are italic; «el-Bekrí» has an acute accent on its last letter.

body L11, L13, L18, L20, L21, L24: the hyphens of «al-Boldân», «al-Hama-», «al-Istakhrí», «al-Khuwārizmī», «ad-dīn» of the head of Naṣīr ad-dīn and «al-Maǵisṭī» are of the thinner sort (3.6-4.2 pt), the others of the thicker; the hyphens of «901-03» and «813-833» measure 3.6 and 4.0 pt. The h of «Khuwārizmī» prints broken.
body L28: «ta‘līq» is in roman type, with the turned comma of the ʿayn and a macron over the i.
body L29: the 6 of «136,v.» prints broken: only its upper end and the left part of its bowl, like «;». The codex has 136 leaves (L25-L26).

body L29-L30: the gloss at the end of the codex: «وفرغ من كتابة الحواشي زين العابدين بن» ends L29, «محمد الحسيني المشتهر بالا ... في حادي عشرين المحرم سنه ٩١٢ (aut ٩١٣)» begins L30, read on the scan at 1400-3600 dpi; «سنه» ends without the two dots of the tā’ marbūṭa, as printed (كتابة has them), and the dots after «بالا» are Nallino's. Inside the run, «(aut ٩١٣)» is set left to right with the Latin word first, as printed; the figures are Arabic-Indic. The stop after the run stands at the right of «محمد».
body L33: the b of «192,b» is italic; the o of «2o» is raised.

notes_left L1-L5, notes_right L1-L4: two notes in two columns, with a thin rule between them; note 2 runs from the left column into the right. «Uri» (note 2) and «Steinschneider» (divided «Stein-», «schneider») are letter-spaced; «iv» and «i» are small capitals. The I of «t. I» in note 2 prints like an l.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
